## Three release-note streams (see memory: gemini-enterprise-third-release-stream)
1. cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/release-notes        — in sources.json, useless
2. docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/release-notes — nav-only, WebSearch it
3. docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes — RENDERS, the productive one

### August 20, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- **Antigravity for IDEs** — "AI agents directly into your integrated development environment",
  now available on Standard, Plus and Pay-as-you-go editions with invoiced billing accounts.
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/ENDPOINT]
- Okta SCIM autocomplete — user/group autocomplete when sharing notebooks and agents, if Okta is the
  external IdP.                                                                          [held]
- Google Identity recommended for third-party data sources with external IdPs using OIDC or
  SAML 2.0 (excludes Microsoft 365 ingestion).                                           [held]

### August 19, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- Subscription seat limits: self-serve capped at 25 seats, invoiced at 1,000.             [held]

### August 18, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- Team-member announcement cards on the app home page.                                   [held]
- Gemini 3.6 Flash GA in US and EU multi-regions, no allowlist for US.                   [held]

### August 17, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- **A2UI / A2A agent registration reaches GA, with A2UI v0.9.** Administrators can register agents
  using **Agent to UI (A2UI)** for custom interfaces and the **Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol** for
  communication with Gemini Enterprise. v0.9 adds **Material Design components**, alongside v0.8.
  The agent is **hosted and maintained by the customer/third party, NOT Google**, must be
  network-reachable by Gemini Enterprise for A2A, and is registered by a Gemini Enterprise
  ADMINISTRATOR via the Cloud console or the **REST API**, making it available to users in a Gemini
  Enterprise app.
  => A2UI means the external agent supplies INTERFACE COMPONENTS (buttons, forms, inputs) rendered
     inside the trusted enterprise surface — a phishing/consent-manipulation surface a text-only
     agent does not have. Two component protocol versions (v0.8, v0.9) to reason about.
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AISPM]
  /gemini/enterprise/docs/a2ui-agents/register-and-manage-an-a2ui-agent
  (also: /a2ui-agents/tutorial-host-agent-cloud-run , /register-and-manage-an-a2a-agent)

### August 14, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- Gemini 3.7 Flash selectable in the mobile app.                                          [held]

### August 13 and earlier — all reported 2026-08-14
Skills (create/upload/share; SKILL.md + scripts/files; admin must enable feature AND sharing;
sharing can require admin review or be immediate; per-user by email; Skill Registry on the Agent
Platform side); Gemini 3.7 Flash GA global/US/EU + Agent Designer workflow agents; GitHub connector
GA with Data Federation and write actions (merge PR, push file, create branch, fork, update issues,
comments); 12 new data stores in preview (Cisco Workspaces, Fibery, Gong, Guru, Hex, LegalZoom,
Mercury, Miro, Ramp, Solve Intelligence, Vanta, Webex Meetings) + write actions on Airtable, Hex,
Miro, Smartsheet.

## AGENT PLATFORM (stream 2) — recovered via WebSearch, docs updated 2026-08-13
- **Agent Registry catalogs FOUR record types**: MCP servers, tools, agents, and **Endpoints** —
  "target destinations to centrally govern the external APIs and services that your agents can
  connect to". An **auth manager and bindings** securely authenticate agents to discovered tools.
  Endpoints = the registry's representation of agent EGRESS; bindings = the concrete grant records
  joining an agent identity to a discovered tool's credential.
- **New IAM governance policies in PRIVATE PREVIEW** (August). Track for public preview.
- Previously reported: Semantic Governance Policy engine + Agent Gateway, Agent Registry GA (Jun 18),
  Agent Observability + default OTel tracing GA, AI Security Findings dashboard GA, Model Armor on
  Agent Gateway GA, AlphaEvolve GA, Memory Profiles GA, Feedback service.
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AISPM]
  /gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/govern/agent-registry

Updated: 2026-08-21 — five new dated entries on stream 3 (Aug 14-20). A2UI/A2A GA is the finding.
